summary: Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc. (NXH), formerly Beyond/Overstock and now a Delaware holding company, disclosed in an October 5, 2026 Form 8-K that it and Fathom Holdings, Inc. (FTHM) mutually agreed to terminate their June 16, 2026 Merger Agreement and Plan of Reorganization, under which Fathom Merger Sub, Inc. would have merged into FTHM in a stock-for-stock transaction. No termination fee or break fee is stated. The termination is by mutual written consent, rendering the agreement null and void. Separately, the company reported preliminary third-quarter results and issued a business update. Watch for the abandoned deal's impact on NXH's strategy and any future FTHM alternatives.
